title: Like him was I, these sloping shoulders, this gracelessness.
html_source: Stephen continues to see himself in the piteous student before him

anchor.text: Like him was I, these sloping shoulders, this gracelessness.
anchor.prefix:
his dull skin. Amor matris: subjective and objective genitive. With her weak blood and wheysour milk she had fed him and hid from sight of others his swaddling bands. 

1986#23
anchor.suffix: My childhood bends beside me. Too far for me to lay a hand there once or lightly. Mine is far and his secret as our eyes. Secrets, silent, stony sit in the dark palaces of both 19
anchor.canonical_text: Like him was I, these sloping shoulders, this gracelessness.
